text: {"lessons":["A strong account gain in one month doesn’t guarantee the next; I should judge progress over time rather than react to short-term moves.","Selling Stock C at a loss and later buying more reminds me to make each trade based on a clear rationale, not just recent price changes or my original cost.","Selling Stock D at a gain felt rewarding, but I should avoid taking profits automatically; I need to weigh each holding against my long-term apartment goal and the rest of my portfolio."]}
